game.title: Alan Wake
game.notes: 32-bit exe (AlanWake.exe, PE machine=0x14C). Ships a from-scratch d3d9.dll forwarding proxy in this project (exports exactly Direct3DCreate9, no hook code as of 2026-09-03).

api_notes: Window title is exactly 'Alan Wake - v<version>' (version string embedded, changes per patch - match on 'Alan Wake' substring, not the full title).
SendInput scancode keyboard + relative mouse work for basic capture/focus operations; menu navigation not yet mapped (Esc tried once, inconclusive - see hazards).

2026-09-05 (home PC): SendInput with SCANCODES did NOT reach this game (Space at the title, twice, once held 0.25 s: nothing); the same keys as VIRTUAL-KEY events (wVk, no scancode flag) worked at once. The dev PC record of 2026-09-04 says scancodes worked there - n=1 each way, so try VK first and fall back. Driver: alan-wake-vr/dev-archive/tools/awdrive.py (+ the awvk helper in the notes).

states.name: gameplay
states.detect: Third-person over-shoulder view, objective text + flashlight-battery dial HUD top-left, continuous non-zero frame delta via BitBlt capture.

states.name: minimized (fullscreen-exclusive focus-loss)
states.detect: GetWindowRect returns the Windows sentinel (-32000,-32000)-(-31840,-31972); IsIconic() == True. BitBlt capture at the window's client origin returns a near-black/tiny image even though the process is alive and CPU/GPU-active.
states.notes: See hazards: this build auto-minimizes on ANY external focus steal while running D3D9 exclusive fullscreen (resolution.xml fullscreen=1). Fix: ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_RESTORE) then SetForegroundWindow - confirmed twice to fully recover the running session with no state loss (same scene, same HUD, same character position both times).

states.name: video_playback
states.detect: Letterboxed fly-over / studio logos; the proxy log shows only c0+4 / c0+5 constant uploads (~200/s). The title's forest and the lighthouse main menu are ALSO video, not 3D: a live projection matrix only exists in the studio logos before the title and in the in-engine intro after the fly-over.

Enter on slot 1 -> load (~30 s) -> the checkpoint's video/cutscene, then gameplay

Enter -> 'Are you sure you want to Quit?' -> Enter
main menu, Continue Game highlighted (~8 s)

routes.notes: Proven twice on 2026-09-05. This is the graceful route; WM_CLOSE is no longer needed.

entry_points.steam_app_id: 108710 (start steam://rungameid/108710). On a fresh install Steam first runs a ~7 s first-run setup that shows in content_log.txt as App Running and exits; the game starts on the SECOND launch attempt (2026-09-05).

console.notes: Not investigated. Esc was sent once mid-session; the follow-up capture landed on what was probably a menu-transition frame (came back near-black) and a re-capture a moment later showed unchanged gameplay with no visible menu - genuinely inconclusive, not a negative result. Window/process state was healthy throughout (not minimized, not crashed).

hazards.hazard: This build auto-minimizes on ANY external focus steal while D3D9-exclusive-fullscreen
hazards.notes: Reproduced twice, from two unrelated causes: (1) sending Alt+Enter - the ALT key alone generates WM_SYSKEYDOWN, which this build appears to treat as losing exclusive-mode focus; (2) merely launching an unrelated GUI application (x32dbg.exe) nearby, with no attach ever made. Both times GetWindowRect reported the Windows-minimized sentinel (-32000,-32000)-(-31840,-31972) and IsIconic()==True, and both times ShowWindow(hwnd, SW_RESTORE) + SetForegroundWindow fully recovered the exact running state with no loss (same scene, same HUD, same character position). DO NOT send Alt+Enter to this game live to try to toggle windowed mode - it does not toggle, it minimizes. Use resolution.xml + a relaunch instead (see entry_points.config_files).

hazards.hazard: A game-window close (WM_CLOSE) produced a Windows crash-report minidump, despite a fast, non-hanging process exit
hazards.notes: PostMessage(hwnd, WM_CLOSE, 0, 0) made the process leave the process list within ~4s with no visible hang - insufficient evidence to call it 'graceful', corrected in-session. A fresh minidump (15,718 bytes) appeared at the exact close time. NOTE for future sessions: that exact byte size also matches ONE of nine pre-existing dumps from an unrelated 2026-08-25 session (the other eight were 216-254 KB, a visibly different/larger fault), which hints this specific small dump may be a repeatable, likely-benign exception the shutdown path always trips - not proven, n=2. Do not copy dump FILE CONTENTS into any repo (a minidump is a memory snapshot that can contain the game's own compiled code/assets - treat it like any other original game file, never distribute it). Recording only size/timestamp metadata is fine. A verified in-game quit route (through a menu) is still unknown and would be worth finding before assuming WM_CLOSE is the best available method.

hazards.hazard: The x64dbg MCP automation bridge did not connect on this machine
hazards.notes: start_session reported a timeout even though x32dbg.exe (32-bit, matching AlanWake.exe's bitness) did launch and run standalone; list_sessions never showed it. Six pre-existing, apparently-stale x64dbg-automate-mcp.exe helper processes were already running on this machine before this attempt, suggesting an estate-wide bridge issue rather than something specific to this game or session. Not a game-specific finding - flagged here because it blocked a live camera-matrix read this session and will block the same approach again until fixed.

hazards.hazard: Proxy: a foreign hook layered on IDirect3D9 vtable slot 16 during the first (throwaway) load - most likely the Steam overlay - makes the second load chain into it and recurse CreateDevice until the process dies (~7 s, 1,669 calls in 1 ms). Timing-dependent: it happened once when the first block lived 700 ms, not on three launches where it lived 16 ms.
hazards.notes: Log tells: 'CreateDevice hook: slot 16 holds ..., not ours' at the first unload, then a burst of 'IDirect3D9::CreateDevice called'. Queued fix: never chain into a foreign slot-16 pointer.

hazards.hazard: A small (~15.7 KB) crash minidump appears in Documents\Remedy\AlanWake at every clean menu quit, with the proxy hooks already removed (n=3: 15,718 / 15,666 B). Benign shutdown-path exception; not ours. Do not commit dump contents.
Pre-creating Documents\Remedy\AlanWakeesolution.xml with fullscreen=0 on a never-run install works: the game came up windowed 1920x1080 on its first real launch, no minimise events in four launches.

notes: 2026-09-04b: the FreeLibrary-at-detach fix is confirmed live - the proxy's second d3d9 load now stays resident and the game renders through it (title + main menu). The proxy owns the real device. [verified-live 2026-09-04]

2026-09-05: handedness read live - g_mViewToClip is LEFT-handed (clip.w = +view.z), stored with registers as rows of a column-vector matrix (+1 at storage index 14). Main camera at c192 in skinned shaders (16:9, near 0.2, far 1000). The engine uploads constants as whole 128-register blocks (c0+128, c128+128). See the alan-wake-vr dossier 4c.
